verificationRegistrySample.documentTitle: Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27: Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) August 3-5, 2026
verificationRegistrySample.evidencePassage: Keep the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) unchanged at 5.25 per cent.
verificationRegistrySample.canonicalClaim: Repo rate unchanged at 5.25% under Governor Sanjay Malhotra; SDF at 5.00%, MSF at 5.50%

verificationRegistrySample.documentTitle: Scale Based Regulation (SBR): A Revised Framework for NBFCs - Upper Layer List 2026-27
verificationRegistrySample.evidencePassage: The Reserve Bank has identified 14 Non-Banking Financial Companies in the Upper Layer (NBFC-UL) for 2026-27
verificationRegistrySample.canonicalClaim: 14 NBFCs identified in Upper Layer under Scale Based Regulation with asset threshold >= ₹1,00,000 crore

verificationRegistrySample.documentTitle: Cabinet approves GOBARdhan (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan) National Circular Bioenergy Scheme
verificationRegistrySample.evidencePassage: Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved GOBARdhan (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan) as the National Circular Bioenergy Scheme with a total financial outlay of Rs 23,731 crore for the period FY 2026-27 to FY 2035-36.
verificationRegistrySample.canonicalClaim: Cabinet approval of GOBARdhan National Circular Bioenergy Scheme with outlay of ₹23,731 crore for FY27 to FY36

verificationRegistrySample.documentTitle: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. 16 of 2026)
verificationRegistrySample.evidencePassage: Section 18(5): Every arbitration award under this section shall be made within a period of 90 days from completion of pleadings.
verificationRegistrySample.canonicalClaim: Parliament passes MSMED (Amendment) Bill 2026; mandatory TReDS for CPSEs, 30 days arbitration referral, 90 days arbitral award, min 50% interim relief
verificationRegistrySample.observedValue: Arbitration referral 30 days, Arbitral award within 90 days, mandatory TReDS

verificationRegistrySample.documentTitle: Consultation paper on the mandatory adoption of a Credit Risk-o-Meter as an additional disclosure mechanism for debt securities
verificationRegistrySample.evidencePassage: SEBI proposes introducing a standardized 6-level colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter for all listed and proposed-to-be-listed debt securities.
verificationRegistrySample.canonicalClaim: SEBI proposes mandatory Credit Risk-o-Meter with 6 colour tiers (Irish Green to Red) mapping credit rating AAA to D
verificationRegistrySample.observedValue: 6-level colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter (Irish Green to Red)
